{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Ravioli|Ravioli]]

==Ingredients==

* 3 [[Cookbook:Tbsp|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*4 tbsp finely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*¾ [[Cookbook:Lb|lb]] [[Cookbook:Veal|veal]], [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], or [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]], finely [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
*12 [[Cookbook:Oz|oz]] frozen or cooked [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]], squeezed and chopped
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] freshly grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmigiano Reggiano]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] ground [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

==Procedure==
# Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a small [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] and soften the onions in it until translucent, about 7 minutes.
# Add the minced meat and cook, stirring constantly, until any trace of pink has gone and all liquid has evaporated.
# Remove from the heat and stir in the chopped spinach, Parmesan cheese, and nutmeg.
# Season to taste.
# Beat the eggs and mix them into the meat mixture.
# Refrigerate or cool to room temperature while you roll the dough.
